title: Core: AS2 with-statement and enumeration
description: Verify AS2 with statement and for..in enumeration compile correctly. with(obj) { x = 1; } compiles to ActionWith (0x94). for (var key in obj) {} compiles to ActionEnumerate2 (0x55). Also verify delete operator: delete obj.prop compiles to ActionDelete2 (0x3B). Tests in packages/core/src/as2/__tests__/withforenum.test.ts.
